name: Cost and Reliability
tagline: Balance the fee against the failures.
brief: Three online providers with different fees and reliabilities — route to keep total cost low.
context: A is cheap but 85% reliable, B is dear but 99%, C sits in between. A failed payment costs $5.
narrative: Every provider is online, so availability is no longer the question — value is. Cheapest by fee (A) fails often enough that the $5 penalties pile up; the safest (B) is reliable but pricey. Route by expected cost so the total stays low across the whole queue.
objective: Process every payment and keep total cost at or below $3.00.
learningObjective: Weighted decisions: pick the option that minimizes a combined cost function, not a single field.
intelligenceExplanation: The provider cards show each expected-cost value (fee plus expected failure cost). In this fixed scenario B has the lower expected cost. Route through B to minimize total spend.
hint: Use the provider whose displayed expected cost is lowest here: WHEN onlineB → DO route-b.
